channel.title: Noty
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
Refresh screenshots, drop the clone reference, build the site from a template

- README leads with the three states and links the site and the DMG; the
holdmynotes.app reference is gone.
- screenshots/ holds the real captures and the README embeds them.
- scripts/build-site.sh rebuilds site/index.html from index.template.html,
inlining the screenshots so the page stays one self-contained file. Editing
the built page by regex kept collapsing all five placements onto one image.
